description: 臺北捷運系統防洪設計標準 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences and railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北市政府捷運工程局. 捷運系統大部分路線均置於地下，為避免遭受水患，在系統設計上均有一定之防洪保護設施。 臺北都會區捷運系統之防洪規劃設計為整體通盤考量捷運設施功能、使用年限、安全需求、工程經濟及配合大臺北地區防洪計畫之堤防安全與保護程度等因素，採用二百年頻率洪水位加五十公分出水高度作為臺北捷運系統之防洪保護標準，而其防護原則與方式係於上述洪水保護標準下之所有... Coverage: 臺北市政府捷運工程局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北市政府捷運工程局. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-04-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
